fusion_diagnosis.conclusion: Research fused combo increases graph/buffer allocation phase ~51.2s while compute saves~4.8s and H2D stays flat. Integration/allocation overhead, not proof that upstream fusion is worse. Instrumented timing separate from formal performance.
